title: LFS degradation for some customers
summary: On November 25, 2026, between 21:30 UTC and 00:28 UTC, Git Large File Storage (LFS) operations on github.com were degraded. During this time, an average of 2% of Git LFS requests failed, peaking at 4%. Many more requests initially failed but succeeded when Git LFS clients automatically retried them, which caused slower uploads and downloads for affected users. Other Git operations were not affected. This was due to a large volume of automated, unauthenticated traffic that overwhelmed the Git LFS

During this time, an average of 2% of Git LFS requests failed, peaking at 4%. Many more requests initially failed but succeeded when Git LFS clients automatically retried them, which caused slower uploads and downloads for affected users. Other Git operations were not affected. This was due to a large volume of automated, unauthenticated traffic that overwhelmed the Git LFS servers in one of our regions, leaving them unable to respond to requests in time.
